name: secdeva/skills/dataflowDiagrams
description: Make the dataflow diagrams of a threat model readable: the diagram layout (following the dataflows, or zones in tree order for layered architectures such as the Purdue model), the context, detailed, zones-and-conduits and label views, merged dataflows, shown and hidden groups, labels and the Targeted views page. Lists the labels in use and the elements without labels.
